desc:
DO. NOT. STOP. DRIVING. at any cost, or it will catch you.
 



Do Not Stop is inspired by various analog horror creatures and stories.

CODES (type them in the lobby: GARAGE > CODES)

LASTSTOP - 250 credits
DONOTSTOP - 200 credits

TOURNAMENT - 250 credits

badges.desc: You turned up at the lot and took the keys. From here on there's only one rule: do not stop.
